_readme: TXR-1406 Seller's Disclosure Notice -- DocuSeal-ready widget list for the disclosure content grid + seller signing widgets. Coordinates are absolute PDF points (612x792, TOP-LEFT origin -- x/y is the top-left corner, y increases DOWNWARD, w/h extend right/down -- matching pdftotext -bbox and scripts/build-txr-1406-packet.js toArea()/bakeAddress() conventions) measured against api/_assets/txr-1406-sellers-disclosure-base64.js via pdftotext -bbox on the rendered page, per the acroform-field-names-lie method -- never guessed from AcroForm field names (this PDF has none; it is a flat/0-AcroForm-field form). role is a generic slot token ("Seller 1"/"Seller 2") resolved to a real signer at send time by scripts/build-txr-1406-packet.js -- NOT a specific person's name, so this map is reusable across deals. Built 2026-09-29 fixing two defects found on the completed test PDF: (1) missing per-page seller initials -- OLD generator (gen-fields.py, 2026-09-25) placed them a full row above the real "Seller:" footer line; SELLER_LINE below is the verified real line position. (2) property address never appearing on pages 2-7 -- NOT a DocuSeal field at all; fixed separately by baking real PDF text via api/_assets/field-maps/txr-1406-address-coords.json before the PDF reaches DocuSeal. Also carries two pre-existing cosmetic fixes verified the same session: Section 11 report-count field no longer overlaps the printed word "attached:"; page 6 seller signature/date/printed-name boxes no longer overlap their own captions. 2026-10-01 (702 Fawndale): full overlay-collision pass per scripts/regression-txr-1406-field-overlay.js -- every field/radio-option rectangle checked against both the printed form text (api/_assets/field-maps/txr-1406-printed-text-bbox.json, from pdftotext -bbox) and every other field on the same page. Fixed 202 collisions: every "Additional Information" choice row (electric/gas/other, owned/leased from, attached/not attached, automatic/manual, wood/gas logs/mock/other) now has a real checkbox per printed blank instead of one oversized free-text box sitting on top of the printed choice words; Section 2 and Section 3 explain areas are now one field per printed ruled line instead of one tall box; HOA, Sec4/6/7/9/11 yes/no pairs, and page-7 utility phone fields no longer sit on their own printed labels.
